12.06.2024 Order No. 1.
This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.

1. .
2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Addl. Standing Counsel for the State.

3. The petitioner is apprehending arrest in connection with Nabarangpur Police Station Case No - 93, Dtd.02.06.2010, corresponding to G.R. case No - 376 of 2010, pending in the Court of learned S.D.J.M, Nabarangpur for the alleged commission of offence under Section 408/420/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
4. It is alleged that the petitioner and one Raj Kumar Behera declared themselves to be the owner of an organization named, "Money Development Organization".
They collected money from general public with promise of higher returns.
Several persons invested money.
After some days, the employees of the organization including the petitioner fled away for which a complaint was lodged by one of the employees of the organization.
5. This Court finds that in the meantime charge sheet has been filed and NBW has been issued against the petitioner showing him as absconder.

6. In such view of the matter, the ABLAPL is disposed of granting liberty to the petitioner to surrender before the Court below within two weeks from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order and to move for bail.
In such event, the Court below shall consider the bail application on its Goutam Patnia @ Patania vs State Of Odisha ....
